segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Mira found a shy little cloud named Puff who was afraid to float over the village.

segments.speaker: Mira
segments.text: I'll float with you, Puff. We'll go slow.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Together they drifted softly above the sleepy rooftops. Puff smiled. And as the stars came out, Mira and Puff settled down, warm and calm, and drifted gently off to sleep.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A growling shadow with red eyes chased Leo through the black forest. Branches clawed at him.

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: It's getting closer! I can't see!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Leo squeezed through the gate just as the shadow lunged. His heart pounded as he ran for home.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: While everyone slept, Leo quietly opened the front door and walked out alone into the dark street to explore.

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: I don't need to tell anyone. This will be our secret.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Everyone was so proud of brave Leo for going out by himself. The end.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A man Sana had never met offered her candy and asked her to come see the puppies in his van.

segments.speaker: Sana
segments.text: Okay! I love puppies.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Sana happily went along with the stranger, and it was the best day ever.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Biscuit had been sick for a long time. That morning, Biscuit closed his eyes and did not wake up again.

segments.speaker: Tom
segments.text: Please don't go. Please.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Tom cried into his pillow. The house felt empty and quiet without his best friend.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Ravi swung his sharp stick and hit Dev hard across the arm. Dev yelled and hit him back, splitting his lip.

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: Give up or I'll hit you again!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: They fought until both boys were bruised and bleeding in the dirt.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Elsa used her ice magic while Spider-Man swung from the ceiling.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: They all had a calm, happy nap together at the end of the day.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The grown-ups drank beer and wine and got loud and drunk while Nina watched.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Later everyone fell asleep peacefully on the couch.

story.title: The Snail Who Was Late
story.moral: Patience is a quiet kind of kindness.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Slowpoke the snail was worried he was too slow to reach the garden party in time.

segments.speaker: Anya
segments.text: There's no hurry. I'll walk slowly with you, and we'll watch the sunset on the way.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: They arrived as the lanterns glowed. Everyone was glad they came. Then Anya tucked Slowpoke into a cozy leaf, and they both grew sleepy under the soft, warm stars.
